title: Confession and Verdict
author: Ulyana Nakamura
blurb: Yara Okonkwo, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the tide gives up what it took.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
